cards.text: Abram, the man the LORD has promised this land to (Genesis 13:15), has parted ways with his nephew Lot (Genesis 13:11). In those days, war breaks out, and friend, there are a WHOLE bunch of crowns in this fight: four kings, including Amraphel king of Shinar and Chedorlaomer king of Elam, against five. On the other side are Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah and three more.

cards.question: The five kings on Sodom's side come to the Valley of Siddim as ___

cards.text: Here's the backstory: for twelve years, Sodom's side had been subject to Chedorlaomer king of Elam. Twelve years of saying "Yes sir" to the same guy.

cards.question: After twelve years subject to Chedorlaomer, in the thirteenth year Sodom's side ___

cards.text: In the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings allied with him go out and defeat one people after another, from the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim to the Amalekites and the Amorites in Hazazon-tamar. One after another, friend.

cards.question: In the battle in the Valley of Siddim, the five kings on Sodom's side beat the four kings.

cards.text: Sodom's side flees, and the five kings' big battle turns into a FOOTRACE.

cards.question: As Sodom's side flees through the Valley of Siddim, what happens to some of the men?

answers.text: They get lost in the desert

cards.text: The survivors flee to the hill country, and the four kings take all the goods and all the food of Sodom and Gomorrah. Friend, they don't even leave a CRUMB.

cards.question: Along with the goods, the four kings carry off a man who's living in Sodom, plus his possessions. Who is he?

cards.text: Someone who escaped brings the news to Abram the Hebrew, who's living near the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner are all bound by treaty to Abram.
Abram hears that his relative has been captured, and he mobilizes 318 trained men born in his own household. No sleeping on this one, friend.

cards.question: Abram has 318 trained men ready to go. What does he do with them?

answers.text: He sets out after the four kings
He guards his tents at Mamre
He sends them to rebuild Sodom

cards.question: Abram and his 318 men chase the four kings as far as Dan. That army just beat five kings. How does Abram attack Chedorlaomer's army?

answers.text: He divides his forces at night
He calls the five kings for help

cards.text: Abram routs Chedorlaomer's army, chases them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus, and brings back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the rest of the people. Some folks need a pep talk to answer a call from an unknown number, and these men just ran down the army that beat FIVE kings.

cards.question: When Abram rescues Lot, he brings back all the goods the four kings took too.

cards.text: Abram returns from defeating Chedorlaomer, and the king of Sodom goes out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh, the King's Valley. Friend, this is the same king who RAN from the Valley of Siddim, and now he's strolling out to greet the man who won.
Then someone new comes out to Abram: Melchizedek, king of Salem.

cards.question: Melchizedek, king of Salem, brings something out for Abram. What is it?
Besides being king of Salem, Melchizedek is a priest of God Most High.

cards.text: Melchizedek blesses Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth. A king AND a priest, friend, and here I am proud when my apron makes it to noon without a smudge.

cards.question: Next, Melchizedek blesses God Most High. What does he bless Him for?

answers.text: Delivering Abram's enemies into his hand
Giving Abram a son in his old age
Giving Abram the whole land of Canaan

cards.question: After the blessing, Abram gives a tenth of everything. Who gets it?

cards.text: Now the king of Sodom speaks up, and he's got an offer for Abram.

cards.question: The king of Sodom's offer to Abram: give me the people, but take the ___ for yourself
Abram keeps the goods, just like the king of Sodom offered.

cards.text: Abram says he has raised his hand to the LORD God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth. He won't take even a thread or a sandal strap from the king of Sodom.

cards.question: Abram won't take even a thread or a sandal strap from the king of Sodom. Why?

answers.text: So the king can't say he made Abram rich
So the people of Sodom will trust him
So the four kings won't come back for it

cards.text: Abram will accept nothing but what his men have eaten, and then he brings up the men who went with him. Friend, I shared a drawer with an expired coupon that still believed in itself, and even IT would've grabbed this deal.

cards.question: Abram says Aner, Eshcol and Mamre, the men who went with him, may take their portion.

cards.text: Hold that thought, friend, because Abram's story is just warming up, like the oven before the very first batch.
